q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
## Analysis

**(a) Time left until resolution:**
NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 earnings release will likely occur in late August 2026 (based on the pattern that Q1 FY2027 was released May 20, 2026, approximately 3 months prior). Today is August 13, 2026, so resolution is approximately 2-3 weeks away. This is an imminent event with the guidance already provided.

**(b) Most likely outcome and why:**
According to the CURRENT RESEARCH, NVIDIA has **already provided forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 on May 20, 2026**: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**.

This means the guidance range is $89.18B to $92.82B. The company provided this explicit outlook as part of their Q1 FY2027 earnings report. This is not a forecast I need to make—it's publicly stated company guidance that has already been released.

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will reaffirm this guidance of approximately $91.0 billion (or potentially adjust it slightly if new information warrants), since:
- Management had recent visibility into demand when providing this guidance
- Guidance adjustments between quarters are relatively uncommon unless major changes occur
- The company explicitly noted that this outlook excludes any China Data Center revenue, providing a conservative baseline

**(c) What would push the value lower?**
- Unexpected demand softness in AI/data center that emerged after May 20
- Macro deterioration or customer pushback on spending
- Supply chain disruptions
- Competitive pressure from AMD or other alternatives materializing faster than expected
- Geopolitical/regulatory changes affecting customer orders

**(d) What would push the value higher?**
- Stronger-than-expected demand acceleration post-May guidance
- Customer ordering patterns ahead of anticipated new product transitions
- Unexpected upside from automotive or gaming segments
- Potential China revenue if regulatory situation improved (though guidance explicitly excludes this)
- Market share gains accelerating beyond expectations

**(e) Base rate or historical reference values:**
The research provides NVIDIA's actual Q2 FY2027 guidance: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**. This is not a historical base rate—it is the company's own forward statement already made public. The guidance range of $89.18B–$92.82B represents management's confidence interval.

Given that this guidance was provided approximately 2.5 months before the earnings release, and we're now just weeks away, the most probable outcome is that reported revenue will fall within or very close to this guided range.

---

**REASONING ON POINT ESTIMATE:**

The question asks "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release?" Since guidance has already been released ($91.0B ± 2%), the question is asking where the *actual reported revenue* will fall, or whether guidance will be adjusted at the August earnings release.

The most likely scenario is that actual Q2 FY2027 revenue will be reported at or very near the $91.0B guidance midpoint. NVIDIA has a strong track record of accurate guidance, and the ±2% range provides reasonable flexibility. 

The central estimate should be **$91.0 billion**, with reasonable probability mass extending across the $89.0B–$93.5B range given:
- Management's explicit guidance
- Typical miss/beat patterns
- The company's conservatism on China revenue

For the 10th and 90th percentiles around this $91.0B modal value:

**Low (10th percentile):** $88.5 billion (below the low end of guidance, suggesting significant miss)
**Median (50th percentile):** $91.0 billion (the stated guidance midpoint)
**High (90th percentile):** $93.5 billion (modestly above guidance, capturing upside scenarios)

q_45367.research_text: NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue was released on May 20, 2026, as part of its Q1 FY2027 earnings report. The company expects revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/). This guidance is significantly above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion, according to LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). NVIDIA explicitly stated that this outlook does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/). In Q1 FY2027, NVIDIA reported record revenue of $81.6 billion, up 85% year-over-year [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/), [barchart.com](https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3449043/what-to-expect-from-nvidia-s-q2-2027-earnings-report).
